games.title: Archery
games.tagline: Draw, aim, allow for the wind
games.details: The bow is on the touch screen and the target on the top screen. Pull down to draw and slide to aim; your sight wavers the longer you hold. Every distance needs the right draw length, and the wind pushes each arrow sideways. Shoot three arrows at 30, 50 and 70 metres and chase a perfect 90.

games.title: Arrow Path
games.tagline: Follow the arrows through every square
games.details: Every square points the way - but not how far. Starting from 1, chain the numbers in order, each one somewhere along the previous square's arrow, until every square is used and you finish on the star. Printed numbers must land in place. 90 puzzles on 4x4, 5x5 and 6x6 grids, each with exactly one chain.

games.title: Backgammon
games.tagline: The ancient race game, against a canny DS
games.details: Classic backgammon against the DS at three levels. Roll, move your white checkers round the board, hit lone rival checkers to send them to the bar and bear off all fifteen first. Legal moves are highlighted, the full use-the-whole-roll rule is enforced, you can undo a turn before it ends, and the DS can even play a turn for you.

games.title: Balloon Pop
games.tagline: Pop them all - but never the spiky ones
games.details: Colourful balloons drift up from the fairground and float across both screens. Tap them on the touch screen to pop them, chain quick pops into combos, and grab golden balloons to slow everything down. Steer clear of the dark spiky balloons, and do not let ten escape off the top.

games.title: Ball Split
games.tagline: Harpoon the bouncing balls - both screens tall
games.details: Big bouncing balls fill a room two screens tall. Touch to fire a harpoon straight up - every ball it touches splits into two smaller, faster ones until the smallest pop. Hold to walk, dodge everything that comes down and clear the room before the clock runs out. Each stage starts with more and bigger balls.

games.title: Basket Catch
games.tagline: Catch the fruit, dodge the rocks
games.details: Fruit tumbles out of a giant tree and falls the full height of both screens. Drag your basket to catch apples, oranges, plums and pears, chain catches for bonus points, and grab the golden apple for a wide basket. Rocks dent the basket - three dents and you are done.

games.title: Batting Cage
games.tagline: Tap the pitch, send it out of the park
games.details: Step up to the plate. Each pitch flies in toward you on the touch screen - tap right on the ball just as it arrives to swing. Perfect timing and placement send it soaring over the wall on the top screen; early or late swings go foul. Hit enough home runs from ten pitches to face faster, curving pitches in the next round.

games.title: Light Beams
games.tagline: Tilt the mirrors, light every crystal
games.details: A lamp throws a beam across a dark board of mirrors, stone blocks and crystals. Tap mirrors to tilt them and bend the light so that it reaches every crystal at once. Fixed mirrors and decoys make later levels a real puzzle, every level is built from a working beam path, and par counts the fewest taps.

games.title: Beat Lanes
games.tagline: Tap the notes, play the tune
games.details: Notes fall down four lanes from the top screen to the line on the touch screen. Tap each lane as its note arrives and you play the melody yourself over a steady beat. Three original songs at three difficulties, with perfect and good timing, combo multipliers and a grade for every run.

games.title: Bin Toss
games.tagline: Flick the paper in - mind the fan
games.details: Crumple, aim, flick. Swipe up on the touch screen to throw paper balls across the office into the waste bin on the far screen. Longer swipes fly further, and the desk fan pushes every throw sideways. Build a streak for double points - three misses and it is home time.

games.title: Blast Maze
games.tagline: Drop bombs, clear crates, outlast three robots
games.details: A frantic arena battle for four little robots - you and three DS rivals. Drop bombs that burst in a cross, break crates to find extra bombs, bigger blasts and speed boots, set off chain reactions and trap your rivals. The last robot standing wins the round; first to three rounds takes the match.

games.title: Block Pop
games.tagline: Pop big groups, clear the board
games.details: A board full of coloured blocks: tap a group of touching blocks of one colour to see what it is worth, tap again to pop it. Blocks drop, columns close up, and the bigger the group the bigger the score. Plan ahead to build huge groups and clear the board for a bonus, with three colour counts and unlimited undo.

games.title: Bluff Dice
games.tagline: Bid, bluff and call liar
games.details: The classic dice-bluffing game against three DS players. Everyone hides five dice under a cup; take turns bidding on how many of a face are on the whole table, each bid beating the last. Call LIAR when a bid sounds too good - lose the challenge and you lose a die. The last player with dice wins.

games.title: Bounce Bricks
games.tagline: One aim, a stream of balls - two screens tall
games.details: Aim once and fire your whole stream of balls up through two screens of numbered bricks. Every hit knocks a brick's number down by one until it breaks; grab the green rings to add balls to your stream. After each turn the bricks step down a row - plan your angles and keep them from reaching the bottom.

games.title: Strike Lanes
games.tagline: Ten-pin bowling down a two-screen lane
games.details: A full bowling lane runs from the foul line on the touch screen to the pins on the top screen. Line up, then flick the ball: the flick sets the angle and pace, and curving it adds hook that bites near the pins. Pins scatter with real collisions, and full ten-frame scoring tracks strikes and spares. Bowl solo, against the DS or with a friend.

games.title: Box Lines
games.tagline: The dots-and-boxes pencil game
games.details: Take turns drawing lines between dots on a 6x6 grid. Close the fourth side of a box to claim it and draw again; most boxes wins. The DS plays at three levels and, at its best, gives away as little as possible when every move costs something. Or pass the DS between two players on a notebook-paper board.

games.title: Box Split
games.tagline: Cut the grid into rectangles that fit
games.details: A tidy logic puzzle. Drag corner to corner to cut the grid into rectangles - each one must hold exactly one number, and that number is its size in squares. Cover every square to finish. 90 puzzles on 6x6, 8x8 and 10x10 grids, each with exactly one answer.

games.title: Back Alley Brawl
games.tagline: Street brawler · 3 stages · 3 bosses
games.details: Fight through the night street, the harbor docks and the neon rooftops. Punch combos, kicks, jump kicks and a spin special; smash trash cans for food. Plays on both screens, made for the iPhone fold.

games.title: Brick Rush
games.tagline: Paddle & bricks across two screens · 12 levels
games.details: Bricks on the top screen, your paddle on the bottom: the ball crosses the fold on every rally. Slide the paddle with your finger, catch capsules for lasers, multi-ball and a wider paddle, and smash through twelve hand-made layouts.

games.title: Island Bridges
games.tagline: Link every island - the numbers tell you how
games.details: A calm logic puzzle in a sparkling sea. Each island shows how many bridges it needs; build them straight across or down, no more than two between any pair, never crossing, until every island is joined into one network. Tap one island and then its neighbour to lay a bridge. Endless generated levels, each built from a real solution.

games.title: Bubble Burst
games.tagline: Bubble shooter across both screens · endless levels
games.details: The bubbles hang from the top screen, your launcher waits at the bottom of the touch screen. Drag to aim with a guide that shows every bounce, let go to fire, and pop groups of three or more. Cut a cluster loose and it all falls for big bonuses. Every colour also has its own symbol.

games.title: Bulb Grid
games.tagline: Light every square of the grid
games.details: A glowing logic puzzle. Place bulbs on the open squares - each one shines along its row and column until a wall stops it. Light every square, but never let two bulbs shine on each other, and give each numbered wall exactly that many neighbouring bulbs. 90 puzzles across easy, medium and hard grids, each with exactly one answer.

games.title: Cage Maths
games.tagline: Every cage makes its target
games.details: Arithmetic meets logic. Fill each row and column with every number once, while every outlined cage makes its target - adding, multiplying or taking the difference as its sign says. Wrong cages and repeats light up red. 90 puzzles on 4x4, 5x5 and 6x6 grids, each checked to have exactly one answer.

games.title: Camp Site
games.tagline: A tent beside every tree
games.details: The tents-and-trees logic puzzle. Every tree needs its own tent right next to it, tents never touch - not even at the corners - and the numbers say how many tents go in each row and column. Tap to pitch a tent, tap again to mark grass. Fifty camps from 6x6 to 10x10, each with exactly one answer.

games.title: Car Jam
games.tagline: Slide the traffic, free the red car
games.details: A packed parking lot and one red car that needs to get out. Cars and trucks only slide along their own lanes, so shuffle them back and forth to clear the way to the exit. Forty lots from gentle to fiendish, each solved by computer to give you a par to beat, with drag controls and unlimited undo.

games.title: Cave Flyer
games.tagline: Hold to climb, let go to drop
games.details: A one-button flying game through an endless cave that spans both screens. Hold to climb and release to fall as the tunnel twists, narrows and speeds up. Weave around rock pillars, grab crystals for bonus points and fly on through mud, ice, crystal and lava caverns.

games.title: Cell Solitaire
games.tagline: Four free cells, all cards face up
games.details: The thinking player's solitaire: every card is dealt face up into eight columns, with four free cells to work with. Build the foundations from ace to king, moving runs down the columns in alternating colours. Tap to pick and drop, tap twice to send a card to its best place, undo freely, and read any long column at full size on the top screen. Thousands of numbered deals.

games.title: Checkers
games.tagline: Jump, capture, crown a king
games.details: Classic 8x8 checkers with compulsory captures, multi-jumps and kings. Tap a piece to see where it can go, then tap the square; pieces glide and hop across the board. Play the DS on easy, normal or hard, where it looks several moves ahead, or two players on one DS. Take back your last move whenever you like.

games.title: Chess
games.tagline: Full chess against the DS or a friend
games.details: Complete chess with castling, en passant, promotion, check, checkmate and stalemate. Tap a piece to see its legal moves, then tap where it goes. Play the DS at three strengths - it searches several moves ahead and weighs captures - or pass the DS to a friend. The top screen keeps the move list and captured pieces, and you can take back moves.

games.title: Claw Grabber
games.tagline: Steer the claw and win the prizes
games.details: A prize machine in your pocket. Slide the claw over the pit, drop it and lift a prize - grab it near the middle or it slips on the way to the chute. Balls, blocks, gems and rare gold prizes are worth different points. Reach each round's target before your credits run out as the claw grip grows weaker.

games.title: Code Breaker
games.tagline: Crack the colour code in ten guesses
games.details: A classic logic game of deduction. The DS hides a code of coloured pegs; every guess earns black and white clues that tell you how close you are. Crack it in ten guesses on the classic or hard board, or set a code of your own and watch the DS reason its way to the answer.

games.title: Colour Gate
games.tagline: Only your colour lets you through
games.details: Tap to hop the ball up through spinning rings, sliding bars and twin wheels, each split into four colours. Touch any colour but your own and the run is over. Colour orbs switch your ball's colour, stars score points, and the climb runs up across both screens.

games.title: Colour Mix
games.tagline: Mix red, green and blue light to match the swatch
games.details: A colourful eye-training game. Set three lights - red, green and blue, each from off to full - and watch your mix appear beside the target swatch. Press MATCH when you think you have it: the closer the mix the more points, and a perfect match against the clock scores best. Ten swatches a game.

games.title: Colour Sort
games.tagline: Pour until every tube is one colour
games.details: Sixty lab puzzles, from three colours up to twelve. Tap a tube, tap another, and pour - but only onto the same colour or into an empty tube, and only as much as fits. Every puzzle is proven solvable, undo is unlimited, and finishing under par earns three stars.

games.title: Corner Hop
games.tagline: Step, jump and race to the far corner
games.details: A classic-style race game for one or two players. Move your ten pieces from your corner to the opposite one - step a square in any direction or jump over a neighbouring piece, chaining jumps across the board in a single move. Build ladders for your own pieces, block your rival's, and fill the far corner first. Play the computer or a friend.

games.title: Crate Push
games.tagline: Warehouse puzzles: push, never pull
games.details: Fifteen original warehouse puzzles. Push every crate onto a marked spot, one at a time, and never pull. Step with the D-pad or tap, tap anywhere to walk there, and undo as far back as you like. Each level shows its par, the fewest moves possible, so you can come back and beat it.

games.title: Cross Hop
games.tagline: Road below, river above, burrows at the top
games.details: Hop a little bunny across a busy road on the touch screen, then ride logs and rafts across the river on the top screen to the five burrows at the very top. Fill all five to clear the level; every level runs faster. Hop with the D-pad or by tapping, and beat the 30-second clock for bonus points.

games.title: Cube Four
games.tagline: Four in a row, in three dimensions
games.details: Noughts and crosses grown up: a 4x4x4 cube with 76 ways to make four in a row - along a layer, straight down, or diagonally through the whole cube. The cube is drawn in 3D on the top screen while you tap its four layers on the touch screen. Play the DS on easy, normal or hard, or pass the console to a friend.

games.title: Dart Throw
games.tagline: Aim above, flick to throw
games.details: A full-size dartboard fills the top screen. Drag on the touch screen to steer a gently swaying sight, then flick the stylus up to throw: too soft lands low, too hard lands high. Play 501 down to an exact zero or race Around the Clock from 1 to 20 and the bull, solo, against the DS at three levels, or with a friend.

games.title: Path Guard
games.tagline: Build towers, hold the road
games.details: Classic tower defence on three maps. Build arrow, cannon, frost and beam towers on the grass beside the road, upgrade them twice, and hold out against endless waves with a boss every ten. The top screen shows the next wave and your tower's stats; double speed keeps things moving.

games.title: Dice Five
games.tagline: Roll, hold, score the best category
games.details: The five-dice category game: roll up to three times a turn, hold the dice you want, then score in one of thirteen categories, from ones to sixes, full house, runs and five of a kind. The full scorecard sits on the top screen and every category button shows what it would score right now. Play solo for your best total, against the DS at three levels, or with a friend.

games.title: Dig Deep
games.tagline: Drill down, fly up, cash in
games.details: Pilot a little digger down through layers of earth that stretch across both screens. Drill toward coal, iron, silver, gold, rubies and diamonds, then fly back up the shaft before your fuel runs dry and sell your haul at the surface. Upgrade your drill to break rock, your tank to go deeper and your hold to carry more.

games.title: Dominoes
games.tagline: Match the ends, empty your hand
games.details: The classic draw game with a double-six set. Match a tile to either end of the line, draw from the boneyard when you are stuck, and go out first to score the pips left in your rival's hand. The line of play snakes across the top screen while your hand sits on the touch screen. First to 100 points wins.

games.title: Domino Run
games.tagline: One push, a winding run, ring the bell
games.details: Plan a chain reaction. Stand dominoes on the board and turn each one to choose which way it falls - every domino knocks down the next, which falls its own way, so your run can wind round walls and corners. Press PUSH and watch it go. Reach the bell to clear the level, and use as few dominoes as you can for three stars.

games.title: Dot Flash
games.tagline: Dots flash up - how many were there?
games.details: A lightning-fast counting game. A scatter of dots flashes on the top screen for a moment and vanishes - tap how many you saw. Small counts you can take in at a glance; bigger ones come in clusters you can add up if you are quick. The flashes get shorter and the counts bigger; three wrong counts and the game is over.

games.title: Echo Pads
games.tagline: Watch, listen, repeat - one more each round
games.details: A memory game of light and sound. The DS lights its coloured pads in a sequence, each with its own note; play it back by tapping the pads or with the D-pad. The sequence grows by one every round until you slip. Try four pads, six pads, or the fast mode that speeds up as you go.

games.title: Eights
games.tagline: Match suit or rank - eights are wild
games.details: A lively shedding card game for you and three DS players. Match the top card by suit or rank, play a wild eight to call a new suit, and draw when you are stuck. Be the first to empty your hand to score the cards left with everyone else, and first to 200 points takes the game.

games.title: Fence Loop
games.tagline: Draw one fence that fits every number
games.details: A loop-drawing logic puzzle. Lay fence between the dots to make one single closed loop - no branches, no crossings, no loose ends. Each number tells how many sides of its square are fence. Cross out the gaps you rule out as you go. 90 puzzles on 5x5, 6x6 and 7x7 grids, each with exactly one answer.

games.title: Field Day
games.tagline: Sprint, jump and throw against the DS athletes
games.details: A three-event athletics meet. Tap the two pads in turn to sprint - same pad twice wastes the stride. In the long jump and javelin, build up speed, press before the line, then stop the swinging needle at a good angle for distance. Beat the two DS athletes for gold; take two golds at a meet to face a stronger field next time.

games.title: Fire Crew
games.tagline: Hose down a tower two screens tall
games.details: Fires are breaking out all over a tower that stands two screens tall. Hold to spray - the water shoots from the hose along the line through your finger, right up to the top floor. Windows left burning get hotter and spread to their neighbours, so pick your targets fast. Last the shift without the tower going up.

games.title: Fireworks
games.tagline: Burst rockets at their peak and chain them
games.details: Light up the night over the city. Rockets climb from the ground and slow as they rise - tap one at the very top of its climb for the biggest burst. Bursts set off every rocket they touch, and each rocket in a chain scores more than the last. Let five rockets fall back unburst and the show is over.

games.title: Deep Line
games.tagline: Dodge going down, hook coming up
games.details: Drop your hook from the boat on the top screen down into an ever-darker sea. Steer around the fish on the way down - touch one and the reel-in starts - then steer into them on the way up to fill your hooks. Deeper fish are worth more. Spend your coins on a longer line and more hooks, and fish your way down to the glowfish and tuna.

games.title: Fleet Logic
games.tagline: Find the hidden fleet from the counts
games.details: A solo logic take on the classic sea battle. A whole fleet of straight ships hides in the grid - the numbers by each row and column tell you how many squares are ship, and no two ships ever touch, not even at a corner. Mark water and ships until the fleet is found. 90 puzzles on 6x6, 8x8 and 10x10 seas, each with exactly one answer.

games.title: Flip Discs
games.tagline: Outflank, flip, take the board
games.details: The classic 8x8 disc-flipping strategy game. Trap a line of your opponent's discs to flip them to your colour; most discs at the end wins. Play the DS on easy, normal or hard, or two players on one DS. Legal moves are hinted, flips animate one by one, and you can take back a move against the DS.

games.title: Color Flood
games.tagline: One colour, one board, few moves
games.details: Start in the corner and flood outward: each move recolours your area and swallows every touching cell of that colour. Turn the whole board one colour before the moves run out. Three board sizes, a satisfying flood wave on every move, and limits taken from a real solution so every board can be won.

games.title: Four Drop
games.tagline: Drop discs, line up four
games.details: Take turns dropping discs into a seven-column grid and be the first to line up four across, down or diagonally. Play the DS on easy, normal or hard, where it thinks several moves ahead, or pass the DS between two players. Wins and draws are tallied on the top screen.

games.title: Fox and Hens
games.tagline: One fox against thirteen hens
games.details: The old farmyard hunt game on a cross-shaped board. Hens step forward or sideways and try to trap the fox or fill the top of the yard; the fox moves any way and captures by jumping, again and again if it can. Play either side against the DS.

games.title: Frog Pond
games.tagline: Hop the lily pads, snap up the flies
games.details: A hungry frog and a pond full of lily pads. Tap a pad within reach to hop there, and land under a buzzing fly to catch it - quick catches build a combo, and golden flies are worth five times as much. Keep moving: a pad you sit on too long starts to sink. Catch enough flies before the round ends to reach a bigger, livelier pond.

games.title: Garden Chase
games.tagline: A busy bee, a hedge maze, four hungry beetles
games.details: Guide a little bee through a hedge maze that spans both screens, gathering every drop of nectar while four beetles hunt it down - each with its own way of chasing. Grab a flower to make them timid and catch them for big points, use the side passages to escape, and clear garden after garden as they get faster.

games.title: Garden Patrol
games.tagline: Stop the long bug - two screens of garden
games.details: A long bug winds down through a mushroom garden two screens tall, turning at every mushroom it meets. Hold to move your sprayer and fire - every segment you hit becomes a mushroom and splits the bug in two. Clear mushrooms with three hits, keep the bug off you and survive wave after longer, quicker wave.

games.title: Gem Swap
games.tagline: Match-3 puzzle · bombs, prisms, endless levels
games.details: Drag gems on the touch screen to line up three or more. Four in a row leaves a bomb gem, five makes a prism that clears a whole colour. Hit the target score before your moves run out. Every gem has its own shape, so it plays well for colour-blind players too.

games.title: Gin Cards
games.tagline: Meld, knock, go gin
games.details: The classic two-player rummy game against a sharp DS opponent. Draw from the stock or the discard pile, build sets and runs, and cut your deadwood until you can knock - or go gin for a bonus. Your melds are colour-coded as you play, the DS lays off on your melds, and the first to 100 points wins.

games.title: Go Fish
games.tagline: Got any sevens? Collect sets of four
games.details: The friendly card game for all ages. Ask the two DS players for a rank you hold - if they have it, they hand it over and you go again; if not, go fish in the pond. Lay down every set of four and finish with the most sets. The DS players remember what you ask for, so keep them guessing!

games.title: Gold Panning
games.tagline: Swirl the pan, wash away the gravel, keep the gold
games.details: A relaxing touch-physics game by the river. Hold the stylus away from the middle to tip the pan that way: light gravel slides and washes over the low rim while heavy gold flakes creep along far more slowly - and a quick shake settles them lower still. Every spill uses water, so dip the pan to refill. Five pans a day; each flake kept scores, gravel left behind costs a little, and a clean pan earns a bonus.

games.title: Mini Golf
games.tagline: 9 putting holes · each one spans both screens
games.details: Tee off on the touch screen and putt toward a cup on the upper screen. Pull back like a slingshot and let go. Nine original holes with walls, sand traps, water, slopes, bumpers and a sweeping windmill bar, plus a scorecard that tracks every birdie and bogey.

games.title: Five in a Row
games.tagline: Line up five on a 15x15 board
games.details: A calm, deep classic: take turns placing stones on a 15x15 board and be the first to line up five across, down or diagonally. The DS weighs every threat and plays at three levels, or pass the DS to a friend. Tap to place, take back moves, and watch the winning line light up.

games.title: Gone Missing
games.tagline: Study the tray, then spot what has vanished
games.details: A sharp little memory game. A tray of coloured shapes appears on the top screen for a few seconds, then the cloth comes down and one thing is quietly taken away - later the rest get shuffled about too. Pick the missing one from the choices. Trays grow, study time shrinks and the look-alikes get closer; three misses and the game is over.

games.title: Gravity Shot
games.tagline: Sling the probe round the planets
games.details: A space puzzle about bending paths. Pull back and let go to launch a probe - every planet tugs it with gravity, so the straight line is rarely the way. Curve round worlds, slip between them and land in the green ring. Thirty levels, each checked to have a way through; use fewer probes for more stars.

games.title: Greater Grid
games.tagline: Every number once, every sign true
games.details: A number logic puzzle with a twist. Fill each row and column with every number once - and make every greater-than sign between neighbouring squares true. A few numbers are printed to start you off; the signs do the rest. 90 puzzles on 5x5, 6x6 and 7x7 grids, each with exactly one answer.

games.title: Hearts
games.tagline: Dodge the hearts, beware the Queen
games.details: The classic trick-taking card game for four: you and three DS players. Pass three cards, follow suit, and steer clear of hearts and the dreaded Queen of Spades - or take them all and shoot the moon. Legal cards are highlighted for you, and the lowest score when someone reaches 100 wins.

games.title: Hex Bridge
games.tagline: Join your edges before the DS joins its own
games.details: A deep connection game on a board of hexagons. Place red stones to build an unbroken chain from top to bottom while the DS races to join left and right with blue. There are never any draws, every stone matters, and the top screen shows how close each side is. Play on 7x7, 9x9 or 11x11 boards.

games.title: Hex Merge
games.tagline: Three alike merge into the next
games.details: Place numbered hexes on a honeycomb board. Three or more touching hexes with the same number merge into one of the next number - and merges can chain. Two sevens make a gem that clears everything around it. The board fills up fast, so plan your spaces.

games.title: Hoop Shot
games.tagline: Flick it up, sink it in a minute
games.details: Arcade basketball across two screens: the ball waits on the touch screen and the hoop hangs on the top screen. Flick the ball up - the direction and speed of your flick shape the arc - and watch it rattle off the rim or swish through. Three for a swish, double points on a hot streak, and a sliding hoop once you pass 20. Sixty seconds, beat your best.

games.title: Sky Hopper
games.tagline: Bounce up through the sky · both screens tall
games.details: Bop bounces by itself: you steer with a finger or the D-pad. Climb springs, moving and crumbling platforms and vanishing clouds, stomp birds, grab stars and balloon rides, from blue sky through sunset into space. Both screens show the climb, so you can see further ahead.

games.title: Hot Dice
games.tagline: Bank it or risk it all - first to 5,000
games.details: A push-your-luck dice game against a cunning DS. Roll six dice, set aside the ones that score - ones, fives, three of a kind, straights and three pairs - then decide: bank your points or roll the rest and risk losing the lot. Score with all six dice and they all come back for another roll.

games.title: Ice Curl
games.tagline: Curling against the DS
games.details: Slide stones down a sheet of ice that runs the length of both screens into the house. Pull back and let go to throw, choose which way the stone curls, and rub the touch screen to sweep it further. Knock out the DS's stones, guard your own, and score the most over four ends.

games.title: Ice Slide
games.tagline: Slide, bump, stop - land on the flag
games.details: A little penguin on a frozen lake can only stop when it bumps into a rock or lands in soft snow. Swipe, tap or use the D-pad to send it sliding and work out the route that brings it to rest on the flag. Every level is checked by a solver that sets par, so you can chase a perfect route.

games.title: Ink Match
games.tagline: Tap the ink colour - not what the word says
games.details: A brain-teasing reaction game. A colour word appears printed in a colour of ink, usually a different one: tap the button for the INK. Now and then the card asks for the WORD instead, so stay sharp. Answers get faster, more colours join in and later the buttons shuffle; a run of right answers multiplies the score, and three mistakes end the game.

games.title: Island Sea
games.tagline: Shade the sea, leave every island its size
games.details: A classic-style island logic puzzle. Shade the sea so that every number sits on its own island of exactly that many squares. Islands never touch side by side, the sea flows as one connected piece, and it never forms a 2x2 pool. 90 puzzles on 5x5, 6x6 and 7x7 grids, each with exactly one answer.

games.title: Jug Measure
games.tagline: Fill, empty and pour to measure the exact amount
games.details: The classic water-jug puzzle. The jugs have no marks - only their full sizes are known. Fill a jug from the tap, empty it out, or pour one into another until the first runs dry or the second is full, and get exactly the amount asked for into any jug. Twelve puzzles with two or three jugs, each with a par of the fewest steps found by searching every way.

games.title: Junction
games.tagline: Work the lights, never crash
games.details: You run the lights at a busy crossroads. Cars pour in from all four sides - tap a light to switch its road between red and green. Let crossing roads into the middle together and it's a crash; keep any road waiting too long and the drivers honk off. Traffic only gets heavier the longer your shift lasts.

games.title: Kart Loop
games.tagline: Three laps, four karts, both screens
games.details: Top-down kart racing on tracks that stretch across both screens. Hold A and steer with the D-pad, or just hold the stylus where you want to go. Stay off the grass, bump past three DS drivers and chase your best lap on the Meadow, Riverside and Canyon circuits.

games.title: Keepy Up
games.tagline: Tap the ball - do not let it drop
games.details: Keep the ball in the air over a sunny park. Tap it on the touch screen to kick it back up across both screens, aim with where you tap, and fly it through the spinning stars for bonus points. Gravity creeps up the longer you last.

games.title: Ladder Climb
games.tagline: Climb the ladders, dodge the slides
games.details: The timeless family race to square 100. Roll the die, climb every ladder you land on and whoosh down the slides. Play with up to four people or let the DS fill the empty seats, and get a brand-new board of ladders and slides every game. Roll a six to go again - but you need the exact number to finish.

games.title: Moon Lander
games.tagline: Set it down gently across two screens
games.details: Pilot a lander down from the top screen to landing pads on the touch screen below. Rotate, burn the engine and watch your speed, fuel and altitude; land upright and slowly, and aim for the narrow pads that pay five times. Gravity grows every level and wind blows from level 4. Three landers per game.

games.title: Land Grab
games.tagline: Slice up the field, dodge the sparks
games.details: Draw lines out into the dark field to cut off chunks of it - every part the sparks cannot reach becomes yours and reveals the pattern underneath. But if a spark touches your line while you draw, you lose a life. Claim 75% of the field across both screens to clear each level; every level adds another spark.

games.title: Lantern Glide
games.tagline: Drift a paper lantern through the night
games.details: A paper lantern rises into the night sky across both screens. Drag to drift it through the gaps between branches and around the night birds, and fly through fireflies to keep its little flame alight. How high can it go before the flame goes out?

games.title: Last Stick
games.tagline: Take sticks in turn - and outthink the DS
games.details: A classic take-away duel with a twist: the rules change every round. Take sticks from one row on your turn - sometimes any number, sometimes no more than three - and in some rounds the one who takes the last stick wins, in others they lose. The DS works out every position exactly; on easier levels it sometimes slips. First to four rounds takes the match.

games.title: Letter Guess
games.tagline: Guess the word before the balloons pop
games.details: A parcel floats on a bunch of balloons, and a hidden word waits below. Tap letters to fill in the blanks - every wrong guess pops a balloon. Use a hint if you're stuck, but it costs a balloon too. Eighteen themes and over two hundred words, with fewer balloons the longer you last.

games.title: Lift Boss
games.tagline: Run the lift and carry everyone before they give up
games.details: A busy little management game. People turn up on every floor with the floor they want shown over their heads. Tap floors to light their buttons and the lift sweeps up and down, stopping at each lit floor - riders step out, the waiting step in, six at a time. Faces turn from green to red as patience runs out, and five fed-up people ends your shift. Meet each day's goal to face a busier building.

games.title: Line Link
games.tagline: Join the dots - no crossing allowed
games.details: A soothing puzzle of coloured lines. Drag from each dot to its matching twin, square by square, without crossing another line. Join every pair to clear the board, and fill every square for a perfect link. Endless generated levels grow from 5x5 to 9x9, and every one has a complete solution.

games.title: Pixel Logic
games.tagline: Picture logic puzzles
games.details: Sixteen original picture logic puzzles in 10x10 and 15x15. The numbers tell you the runs of filled cells in each row and column; fill the grid to satisfy them all and a picture appears. Column clues sit on the top screen right above their columns, with a live thumbnail of your picture. Tap or drag to fill, mark cells you know are empty, and beat your best times.

games.title: Ludo
games.tagline: Roll, race and send rivals home
games.details: The much-loved race game for one to four people. Roll a six to bring a token out, race around the board and into your home column, and land on rivals to send them back to their base - except on the safe star and start squares. The DS fills any empty seats with a crafty opponent.

games.title: Marble Chain
games.tagline: Match three before the chain reaches the hole
games.details: A chain of coloured marbles winds down a temple path across both screens toward the hole. Aim and fire marbles into the chain - three or more of a colour vanish, and matching ends snap back together for combos. Swap with the next marble when you need to, and clear the chain before it rolls home.

games.title: Ball Maze
games.tagline: Tilt the board, roll to the goal
games.details: A wooden labyrinth that runs down through both screens. Hold the touch screen to tilt the board toward your stylus and roll the ball from the start at the top to the green goal at the bottom, past trap holes that send you back to the start. Every maze is freshly built and they grow with each level.

games.title: Maze Tanks
games.tagline: A tank battle through a maze
games.details: A top-down tank duel through a maze that spans both screens. Drag to drive, tap to fire, and use the walls - shells bounce a few times before they burst, so line up trick shots (and watch out for your own). First to five hits wins, with a new maze every round.

games.title: Merge Tiles
games.tagline: Slide, merge, double up
games.details: Swipe to slide every tile; equal tiles merge into one worth double. Play the classic 4x4 board or the roomier 5x5, with three undos per game. The top screen tracks your score, your best and every tile you've reached on the way to 2048 and beyond.

games.title: Meteor Dodge
games.tagline: Weave through the meteor shower
games.details: A meteor shower pours down both screens. Drag to fly your little ship through the gaps, scrape past rocks for near-miss bonuses, and grab blue crystals and shields on the way. The shower gets thicker and faster the longer you last - three hits and the flight is over.

games.title: Mill
games.tagline: Nine stones, three squares, one sharp rival
games.details: The ancient strategy game on three nested squares. Place your nine stones, then slide them along the lines; every row of three you make takes one of your rival's stones. Down to three stones, you can fly anywhere. Play the DS at three levels or a friend, with undo and clear hints for every phase.

games.title: Mine Field
games.tagline: Logic puzzle · 3 field sizes · touch to dig
games.details: Clear every safe tile without setting off a mine. Each number tells you how many mines touch that tile. Tap to dig, hold to plant a flag, tap a number to clear around it. The first dig is always safe. Bolt the robot keeps your mine count and time on the top screen.

games.title: Mirror Draw
games.tagline: Trace the shape while your pen moves mirrored
games.details: A brain-twisting drawing challenge. Trace the shape on the top screen by drawing on the touch pad - but your ink comes out mirrored. Left-right first, then up-down, both ways, and finally flipped across the diagonal. Pass every dot before time runs out, and stay on the band for a neat three-star finish. Twelve shapes from squares to spirals, then they come round again with less time.

games.title: Mole Mayhem
games.tagline: Whack-a-mole · 60 seconds of tapping
games.details: Moles pop out of nine holes on the touch screen: bonk them before they duck. Helmet moles need two hits, gold moles are worth five times as much, and the bunnies with flowers are friends. Keep a streak for a bigger multiplier as the round speeds up.

games.title: Nine Grids
games.tagline: Noughts and crosses, nine boards deep
games.details: Noughts and crosses with a twist: nine small boards inside one big board. Take a small board with three in a row, and take the game with three boards in a row - but every square you choose sends your opponent to the matching board. Play the DS at three levels or a friend, with undo.

games.title: Number Chain
games.tagline: One chain from 1 through every square
games.details: A path-finding number puzzle. Start on the 1 and drag a chain from square to square - each square you enter takes the next number, and the printed numbers must land exactly in place. Fill the whole grid with one unbroken chain. 90 puzzles on 5x5, 6x6 and 7x7 grids, each with exactly one answer.

games.title: Number Line
games.tagline: Tap where the number belongs - only the ends are marked
games.details: A sharp estimation game. A number appears with a line whose two ends are labelled - tap where the number sits. The closer you are, the more points, and a dead-on tap scores a bonus. Ten rounds a game, with lines from 0-10 up to 0-1000 and lines that do not start at zero.

games.title: Number Target
games.tagline: Combine the numbers to hit the target exactly
games.details: A quick-thinking numbers game. Join two tiles at a time with add, subtract, multiply or divide - the pair becomes their result - until one tile shows the target. Puzzles grow from four small numbers to six tiles with big numbers and three-digit targets. Every puzzle is built from real moves, so there is always a way, and if you pass, one way is shown. Undo freely; beat the clock for a bigger score.

games.title: Odd Coin
games.tagline: Find the fake coin in just a few weighings
games.details: The classic balance puzzle, with a crafty opponent. One coin is a fake - heavier, lighter, or in the hardest rounds you must find out which. Put coins on the two pans and weigh, but you only get a few weighings. The banker keeps the fake wherever your weighings leave the most room, so only a plan that always works will catch it. Nine rounds up to the famous twelve coins in three weighings.

games.title: Odd One Out
games.tagline: One is different - can you spot it?
games.details: A fast and fiendish observation game. Every grid is full of identical shapes except one: a slightly different shade, a touch smaller, or a sneaky look-alike letter. Tap it to add time to the clock as the grids grow and the differences shrink. Wrong taps cost seconds - how far can you go?

games.title: Paddle Duel
games.tagline: Neon paddle tennis · vs CPU or 2 players
games.details: Your paddle on the bottom screen, your rival's on the top: every rally crosses the fold. Drag to move, hit on the move for spin, grab the power orb for a wider paddle. Play Rookie, Pro or Champion CPUs, or pass the device across the table for two players.

games.title: Memory Pairs
games.tagline: Turn two, remember, match them all
games.details: The classic card-matching memory game with sixteen bright symbols. Play solo on four board sizes from 4x3 to 6x5 and beat your fewest moves, or take turns against the DS, whose memory gets sharper at each level. Cards flip with a quick animation and every pair you find is collected on the top screen.

games.title: Pancake Stack
games.tagline: Flip at golden, stack and serve
games.details: Run the griddle at a busy breakfast diner. Pour batter into four pans, flip each pancake when its underside turns golden, then stack it on the plate. Add berries or syrup to match the order and serve before the customer runs out of patience. Perfect stacks earn the most - burnt ones go in the bin.

games.title: Paper Route
games.tagline: Deliver to every green flag - both screens tall
games.details: Pedal up a street two screens tall and deliver the morning papers. Tap a side to throw, hold to steer. Green-flag mailboxes are subscribers - hit every one for a perfect day - but red flags didn't order a paper. Dodge oncoming cars and potholes, grab paper bundles to restock, and take on a busier street each day.

games.title: Patience
games.tagline: Klondike solitaire · drag, tap, undo, auto-finish
games.details: The classic solitaire, made for the touch screen: drag cards between piles or tap-tap to move them, double-tap to send a card home, undo any move, and let auto-finish play out a solved game. Draw one or draw three. Score, time and your win record sit on the top screen.

games.title: Peak Cards
games.tagline: Up or down by one, clear three peaks
games.details: A brisk patience game played on three mountain peaks of cards. Tap any uncovered card one rank above or below the waste card to play it, chain long runs for bigger scores, and turn the stock when you are stuck. Clear all three peaks for a big bonus and see how high your score can climb.

games.title: Pearl Loop
games.tagline: Draw one loop through every pearl
games.details: A calm logic puzzle with two simple rules. Drag across the squares to draw a single closed loop that passes through every pearl. On a black pearl the loop must turn, then run straight on through the next square both ways. On a white pearl it goes straight through, and turns just before or just after. Twenty-two puzzles from five-by-five to seven-by-seven, each with exactly one answer checked by computer search. Undo, hints and clear are always there.

games.title: Peg Drop
games.tagline: Bounce through the pegs, clear the orange ones
games.details: Aim from the top of the top screen and watch the ball bounce down through a field of pegs that runs across both screens. Every peg it touches lights up and vanishes; clear all the orange pegs before you run out of balls. Long bounce chains multiply your score, and the moving bucket gives the ball back.

games.title: Jump Peg
games.tagline: Peg solitaire: end with one
games.details: The classic solo puzzle on a wooden board. Jump pegs over their neighbours into empty holes, removing each jumped peg, and try to finish with a single peg. Three boards - the 33-hole Cross, the 15-hole Triangle and the 41-hole Diamond - with legal jumps highlighted, unlimited undo and your best result for each board.

games.title: Penalty Kick
games.tagline: Take five, save five
games.details: A penalty shootout against the DS. Flick the ball from the spot toward the goal on the top screen - sideways to aim, faster to lift it, curved to bend it - and beat the diving keeper. Then pull on the gloves: tap the dive pad to guess early or react to the shot. Five kicks each, then sudden death, at three levels.

games.title: Picture Swap
games.tagline: Swap the tiles back into the picture
games.details: Twenty-four hand-drawn pictures - a cottage, a sunset, hot-air balloons, a fish tank, a night city and more - are cut into tiles and shuffled. The finished picture waits on the top screen; tap two tiles on the touch screen to swap them. Finish in the fewest swaps for three stars, from a 3x3 warm-up up to 8x6.

games.title: Piece Fit
games.tagline: Pack every piece into the frame
games.details: A relaxing packing puzzle with nothing falling and no countdown. Drag pieces of three, four and five squares from the tray, turn and flip them, and fit them all into the frame. Thirty levels grow from small rectangles to big frames with gaps to work around - every one has a way to fit.

games.title: Fold Pinball
games.tagline: A pinball table as tall as both screens
games.details: Pop bumpers, F-O-L-D rollover lanes and drop targets on the upper screen; slingshots, flippers and the HINGE kicker on the lower one. Flip with the shoulder buttons or by touching either side of the screen, nudge carefully, and light every lane to raise your multiplier.

games.title: Pipe Link
games.tagline: Turn the pipes, connect the flow
games.details: Every board is one scrambled network of pipes with a pump in the middle. Tap pieces to turn them and watch water flow into every piece you connect. Link them all with no open ends to win. Endless generated boards in 5x5, 7x7 and 9x9, with your fewest moves remembered.

games.title: Planet Merge
games.tagline: Drop, bump, merge - grow a sun
games.details: Drop planets into a tall jar that spans both screens. When two of the same kind touch they fuse into the next size up - dust, rocks, moons, ice worlds, oceans, ringed planets, gas giants and finally a blazing sun. Plan your drops, chain merges for big scores, and keep the pile below the line.

games.title: Plate Spinner
games.tagline: Keep every plate spinning on its pole
games.details: A frantic juggling act. Each plate slows down by itself - some faster than others - and wobbles more and more as it does. Tap its pole to give it a fresh spin before it drops. Every fifteen seconds another pole joins the act, and the plates tire faster as the show goes on. Three broken plates and the curtain comes down.

games.title: Pixel Hop
games.tagline: Platformer · 6 worlds · stomp, jump, collect
games.details: Guide Hop the round orange critter across the meadow, desert, cave, snow, dusk and sky worlds. Stomp slimes, hoppers and birds, bump gift crates for coins and reach the portal. The touch screen shows a map of the whole level and big buttons for playing by touch.

games.title: Pocket Farm
games.tagline: Plant, water, harvest - beat the sunset
games.details: Run a busy little farm. Plant carrots, tomatoes and pumpkins, water them before they wilt and harvest them before they spoil. Market orders appear on the top screen and fill themselves from your barn - earn the day's coin target before sunset to move on to an even busier day.

games.title: Pocket Pool
games.tagline: 8-ball across two screens
games.details: A full pool table stretched over both screens. Drag back on the touch screen like a slingshot to aim and set power, follow the guide line to the ghost ball, and let go. Pot your solids or stripes, then the 8 ball; scratches and wrong-ball fouls give ball in hand. Play the DS on three levels or a friend.

games.title: Air Puck
games.tagline: Air hockey across two screens
games.details: A full air-hockey table spread over both screens. Drag your mallet on the touch screen and fire the puck up the table into the DS's goal at the top. Hits keep their speed and angle, rebounds come off the rails, and the DS plays on easy, normal or hard. First to seven goals wins.

games.title: Pyramid Cards
games.tagline: Pairs that make 13 bring it down
games.details: The classic pyramid patience: remove pairs of uncovered cards that add up to 13 - kings go alone - and use the stock and waste pile to find the pairs you need, with three passes through the stock. Every one of the sixty deals has been checked by a solver and can be won, and undo is always there.

games.title: Pyramid Hop
games.tagline: Hop every cube top to the new colour
games.details: A bouncy arcade puzzle on a pyramid of cubes. Tap the side you want to hop toward and change the colour of every top you land on. Red balls bounce down from the summit and a purple egg hatches into a chaser that hunts you down - and one hop too far sends you off the edge. Later pyramids need two hops per top, then start flipping back.

games.title: Highway Havoc
games.tagline: Motorbike combat racer · 3 races
games.details: Race seven rivals down the coast highway, across the desert and through the city at night. Punch riders off their bikes, dodge traffic, save your nitro for the last stretch and finish in the top three to move on.

games.title: Rail Switch
games.tagline: Flip the points, route every train home
games.details: Colourful trains roll out of the tunnel one after another, and every junction sends them whichever way its switch points. Tap the switches to guide each train to the station of its own colour. Three wrong arrivals end the run, and every level adds stations, trains and speed.

games.title: Reflex Duel
games.tagline: Who is faster? Find out in a flash
games.details: A party game of split-second reactions for two people sharing one DS - or for you against the DS at three speeds. Win a quick draw, snap matching colour cards and stop the count at exactly seven stars. Jump the gun and the point goes to your rival. Your reaction time is shown in milliseconds.

games.title: Ring Tower
games.tagline: Move the whole stack, never a big ring on a small one
games.details: The timeless ring-and-peg puzzle with eighteen levels. Tap a peg to lift its top ring and tap another to drop it - but a ring can never sit on a smaller one. Every level is solved exactly when it starts, so the par is the true fewest moves and a hint always points to a best move. Later levels bring a fourth peg and scrambled starting stacks. Undo is free; match the par for three stars.

games.title: River Cross
games.tagline: Ferry everyone over without leaving trouble behind
games.details: Classic river-crossing puzzles in two flavours. In the farmer puzzles the farmer rows with only so many passengers, and some can never be left together alone - the fox will eat the hen. In the knights and thieves puzzles anyone can row, but thieves may never outnumber knights on a bank. Tap who boards, then GO. Every puzzle was solved by search, with a par for the fewest crossings.

games.title: Robo Path
games.tagline: Program the robot, run it to the flag
games.details: A thinking game about planning ahead. Build a program from FORWARD, LEFT and RIGHT cards, press RUN and watch the robot follow it card by card. Bump a wall or roll off the edge and it's back to the drawing board. Thirty levels, with gears to collect on the way in later ones - match the shortest program for three stars.

games.title: Rock Storm
games.tagline: Vector rock shooter · wrap-around two-screen arena
games.details: Neon vector rocks drift through a wrap-around arena as tall as both screens. Rotate, thrust and blast them into smaller and smaller pieces, dodge the saucers, and hyperspace out of trouble. Or just hold a finger on the lower screen: the ship turns toward it and fires.

games.title: Rope Swing
games.tagline: Grab, swing and climb
games.details: Shoot your rope to the hooks above and swing your way up the sky across both screens. Tap the left or right half of the touch screen to grab the nearest hook on that side - the rope reels you in, so keep reaching higher. The view keeps rising faster and faster; grab stars on the way and do not drop off the bottom.

games.title: Rooftop Run
games.tagline: Endless runner · city rooftops at night
games.details: Sprint across the rooftops of a city at night. Tap to jump and tap again for a double jump, swipe down to slide under signs and drones, grab coins, magnets and shields. Every run gives you three fresh missions on the touch screen. How far can you go?

games.title: Safe Cracker
games.tagline: Turn the dial and feel for the click
games.details: A tense game of touch and timing. Drag the dial round - right for the first number, left for the next - and watch the listening meter swing as you close in. When the dial clicks, press SET to open a tumbler. Wrong numbers earn strikes, and the clock is ticking. Later safes have longer combinations and quieter clues.

games.title: Sand Timer
games.tagline: Flip the hourglasses to measure the exact time
games.details: A classic brain-teaser brought to life. You have two or three hourglasses and a time to measure - say exactly 15 minutes with a 7 and an 11. Flip any glass, let the sand run, and act only when one runs out. Ring the bell on the exact minute to solve it. Twenty-four puzzles checked by computer search, each with a par for the fewest flips.

games.title: Sea Battle
games.tagline: Your fleet above, enemy waters below
games.details: The classic fleet-sinking duel, made for two screens: your fleet sits on the top screen while you fire into hidden enemy waters on the touch screen. Arrange your five ships, then trade shots with the DS, from easy random fire to a hard hunter that reasons about where ships can hide. Hits flare, sunk ships are revealed and named.

games.title: Seed Pits
games.tagline: The ancient sowing game
games.details: Six pits a side, four seeds in each. Scoop up a pit and sow its seeds one by one around the board; land your last seed in your store to go again, or in an empty pit of yours to capture the seeds opposite. Watch every seed drop, play the DS at three levels that look ahead, or pass the DS to a friend.

games.title: Shade Out
games.tagline: Shade squares until no number repeats
games.details: A calm logic puzzle. Shade squares so that no number appears twice in any row or column - but shaded squares can never touch side by side, and the open squares must all stay joined. Circle the squares you know must stay. 120 puzzles across easy, medium and hard grids, each with exactly one answer.

games.title: Sheep Herd
games.tagline: Guide the flock into the pen
games.details: You are the sheepdog. Touch the field to send the dog running - the sheep move away from it and like to stay together, so circle round behind them and walk the flock to the gate. Pen every sheep before sunset. Each field brings more sheep, rocks and bushes in the way and a pen in a new corner.

games.title: City Shield
games.tagline: Stop the missiles before they land
games.details: Missiles streak down from the top screen toward six cities on the touch screen. Tap to launch interceptors from three batteries; every blast destroys what it touches and sets off more blasts. Waves get faster, later missiles split in two, and you earn bonuses for every city and interceptor left, plus a rebuilt city every 10,000 points.

games.title: Star Lancer
games.tagline: Two-screen space shooter · 3 sectors · 3 bosses
games.details: One tall battlefield across both screens: waves dive in from the top while you weave your fighter below. Drag the ship with your finger or use the D-pad, power up to a four-way spread, save bombs for the bosses.

games.title: Shove Ring
games.tagline: Push your rival out of the ring
games.details: A quick, physical pushing contest. Hold the stylus where you want to drive and your wrestler leans that way; let go to stand firm. Driving burns stamina, so pick your moments - and beware a rival who sidesteps a charge and lets you sail past the edge. Win three bouts to beat each of five rivals, every one heavier, stronger or craftier than the last.

games.title: Sight Count
games.tagline: Shade squares so every number sees just enough
games.details: A neat logic puzzle about lines of sight. Each number counts the open squares it can see along its row and column, itself included, until a shaded square or the edge blocks the view. Shade squares to make every count come true - shaded squares never touch side on, numbers stay open, and all open squares must join up. Twenty-two puzzles from five-by-five to seven-by-seven, each with exactly one answer checked by computer search.

games.title: Ski Jump
games.tagline: Time the take-off, fly, land clean
games.details: Speed down the in-run on the top screen and tap right at the edge for a big take-off. Gusts tip you in the air - tap left or right to stay level, because a level jumper flies further, and land level for top style marks. Two rounds against five DS jumpers for gold.

games.title: Sky Bridge
games.tagline: Not too short, not too long
games.details: Hold to grow a pole from the edge of your tower - all the way up into the top screen if you need to - then let go so it tips over into a bridge. Make it just long enough to reach the next tower; too short or too long and down you go. Land on the red mark for perfect bonuses.

games.title: Slalom
games.tagline: Carve through the gates, beat the clock
games.details: Race down a snowy mountain that runs across both screens. Turn through seven skiing angles, tuck for speed and dig in to slow down, or steer with the stylus. Pass between every pair of flags - each miss costs five seconds - and keep clear of the trees on the green, blue and black runs.

games.title: Slice Rush
games.tagline: Swipe to slice · classic and 60-second rush
games.details: Fruit flies up from below the touch screen, arcs into the upper screen and tumbles back down. Swipe to slice it, cut several in one swipe for combo bonuses, and never touch a bomb. Play Classic with three lives, or a frantic 60-second Rush.

games.title: Slide Puzzle
games.tagline: Sliding tiles and lights off
games.details: Two classic puzzles in one. Sliding Tiles: put a scrambled picture back together on 3x3, 4x4 or 5x5 boards, sliding whole rows and columns with a tap, with the target picture on the top screen. Lights Off: each tap flips a light and its neighbours; switch them all off through ever-harder levels with a par to beat.

games.title: Neon Serpent
games.tagline: Snake arcade across both screens · 8 levels
games.details: A glowing serpent in a tall arena that spans the fold. Swipe or use the D-pad, eat twelve orbs to open the exit, chase fading gold orbs for big points, and survive eight walled levels that keep getting faster.

games.title: Snap
games.tagline: Quick hands win the pile
games.details: The reaction card game against the DS. Cards turn onto the pile faster and faster; the moment the top two match, hit SNAP before the DS does and the whole pile is yours. Snap at the wrong time and you pay two cards. Pick how quick the DS is - slow, quick or lightning - and win every card.

games.title: Sneak Out
games.tagline: Slip past the guards to the exit, one step at a time
games.details: A turn-based stealth puzzle. Every time you step or wait, each guard takes one step along its beat - and looks four squares ahead the way it is about to walk. Time your moves, duck behind walls and wait for the right moment to slip past. Twenty levels, each escaped by a computer search over every square and moment, with a par for the fewest turns. Undo freely when you are spotted.

games.title: Snowball Fort
games.tagline: Pop up, throw, duck - a friendly snowball fight
games.details: A cheerful snowball fight in the back yard. Kids bob up behind the snow banks: tap one to lob a snowball - it takes a moment to land, so pick the ones who stay up. When a kid winds up and throws, hold DUCK before it reaches you; ducking also packs fresh snowballs. Gold hats are worth five times more. Each wave needs more hits, and five hits on you means it is time for cocoa.

games.title: Spades
games.tagline: Bid, trump and partner up
games.details: The partnership trick-taking game: you and your DS partner North against West and East. Bid how many tricks you will take, follow suit, and remember that spades always trump. Make your team's bid for 10 a trick, watch out for bags, and go nil for a big bonus. First team to 300 wins.

games.title: Spider Cards
games.tagline: Two decks, ten columns, eight runs to build
games.details: The great two-deck patience. Build down by one across ten columns, gather runs in a single suit, and lift off each complete King-to-Ace run. Tap a card and it moves to the best spot; deal ten new cards when you are stuck. Play with one, two or four suits, with unlimited undo.

games.title: Spin Target
games.tagline: Throw knives into the spinning log
games.details: Tap to throw knives up into a spinning log on the top screen. Every knife that sticks turns with the log, so the gaps keep moving - hit a knife that is already there and it is over. Slice apples on the rim for bonus points, and watch out for the tough logs that speed up and spin back the other way.

games.title: Spiral Drop
games.tagline: Spin the tower, drop through the gaps
games.details: A ball bounces down a tall spinning tower that runs across both screens. Drag to turn the tower so the ball drops through the gaps in each ring - but never let it land on red. Drop through three rings in a row and the ball becomes a fireball that smashes whatever is next.

games.title: Spot Five
games.tagline: Two pictures, five differences
games.details: The original picture sits on the top screen and a sneaky copy on the touch screen. Find all five differences before the clock runs out - recoloured objects, missing details, new additions and mirrored patches. Twenty-four scenes, and the differences are different every time you play.

games.title: Stack Up
games.tagline: Tap to drop, build to the sky
games.details: A one-touch tower builder that climbs from the touch screen into the sky on the top screen. Tap to drop each sliding block; anything hanging over the edge is sliced off and tumbles away, so every miss makes the tower narrower. String three perfect drops together to grow the block back. Blocks speed up as you climb from blue sky into starry space.

games.title: Star Hop
games.tagline: Hop across the star before the DS does
games.details: The classic race across a six-pointed star. Move your ten red pegs from one point of the star to the opposite point - step to a neighbouring hole or chain long hops over other pegs. Every reachable hole lights up when you pick a peg. Race the DS at three levels and fill its starting point first.

games.title: Star Place
games.tagline: One star per row, column and region
games.details: A colourful logic puzzle. Place exactly one star in every row, every column and every coloured region - and never let two stars touch, not even at a corner. Mark empty squares with dots as you reason it out. 90 puzzles across 6x6, 7x7 and 8x8 grids, each with exactly one answer.

games.title: Steady Beat
games.tagline: Keep the beat after the metronome stops
games.details: A test of rhythm. The metronome clicks eight beats - tap along - then falls silent while you keep going for sixteen more on your own. Every tap is measured against where the beat should be, and the timeline shows whether you drifted, dragged or rushed. Five rounds at different tempos.

games.title: Stones
games.tagline: The ancient territory game on a 9x9 board
games.details: Place black and white stones, surround to capture, and wall off territory. Learn with Capture 5 - first to take five stones wins - then play the full game with area scoring and komi. Play the DS or a friend; touch and slide to aim with a ghost stone, lift to place.

games.title: Number Grid
games.tagline: Number-placement puzzles · always one solution
games.details: Classic 9x9 number puzzles, generated fresh on your device in easy, medium and hard, each with exactly one solution. Tap a cell and a number, switch to pencil notes, erase, or ask for a hint. The top screen shows which numbers can still go in the selected cell.

games.title: Sum Cross
games.tagline: Every run must add up
games.details: The cross-sum number puzzle. Fill the white squares with digits 1 to 9 so every run across and down adds up to its clue - with no digit used twice in a run. The top screen lists every set of digits that could fit the square you have selected. Fifty puzzles, each with exactly one answer.

games.title: Quick Sums
games.tagline: Fast maths, against the clock or the DS
games.details: A brisk mental-arithmetic workout. Tap the right answer of four as sums of adding, taking away, times and sharing fly by. Sprint for 60 seconds as the sums get harder, or duel the DS head to head at three speeds - first to ten wins. Wrong answers lock you out for a moment, so think fast but carefully.

games.title: Table Soccer
games.tagline: Rod football against the DS
games.details: A football table that runs the length of both screens. Slide all four of your rods together by dragging on the touch screen and tap to swing them and kick. Block, pass between rods and fire it past the DS goalie - first to five goals wins.

games.title: Tangle Free
games.tagline: Drag the dots until no lines cross
games.details: A soothing spatial puzzle. Each web of dots and lines can be laid out flat with no crossings - it just starts all tangled up. Drag the dots around the touch screen and watch the red crossing lines turn calm blue. Every web you untangle brings a bigger one, with no limit on how far you can go.

games.title: Tank Duel
games.tagline: Artillery duel · craters, wind, 4 shell types
games.details: Two tanks, one hilly battlefield that craters wherever a shell lands. Drag on the aiming pad to set angle and power, read the wind, then choose a standard, triple, heavy or bouncing shell. Beat the CPU three rounds out of five, from easy to sharpshooter.

games.title: Court Tennis
games.tagline: Top-down tennis, net on the seam
games.details: A full tennis court spans both screens with the net right on the hinge. Touch where you want to run and swing as the ball arrives - where it meets the racket sets the angle, and holding A plays a hard, flat shot. Real tennis scoring with deuce and advantage, against the DS at three levels; first to four games takes the set.

games.title: Tile Pairs
games.tagline: Match free tiles, clear the stack
games.details: A relaxing tile-matching solitaire. Eighty-eight tiles are stacked in three layers; a tile is free when nothing covers it and one side is open. Match free tiles with the same symbol to clear the table. Every deal is built so it can be cleared, with hints, unlimited undo and a shuffle for when you get stuck.

games.title: Time Sense
games.tagline: Stop the watch on the exact second - in the dark
games.details: How good is your inner clock? Start the watch and it runs for a moment before the display goes dark - then count in your head and tap STOP on the target second. Within a tenth of a second is a bullseye. Eight targets a game, from three seconds up to fifteen.

games.title: Torch Walk
games.tagline: Get everyone over the night bridge in time
games.details: The classic night-bridge puzzle. Each walker takes their own time to cross; at most two go at once, they need the single torch, and a pair moves at the slower walker's pace - so someone has to bring the torch back. Get everyone across within the limit, which is always the fewest minutes possible. Eleven bridges from two walkers to six.

games.title: Tower View
games.tagline: How many towers can you see?
games.details: The skyscraper logic puzzle. Every row and column holds one tower of each height, and the numbers around the edge tell you how many towers are visible from there - taller towers hide the shorter ones behind them. Fill in the grid on the touch screen and watch your city rise in 3D above. Fifty puzzles from 4x4 to 6x6, each with exactly one answer.

games.title: Light Trails
games.tagline: Last cycle running wins
games.details: Race light cycles across an arena that spans both screens. Every cycle leaves a solid wall of light - cut the others off and make them crash into your trail. Swipe to steer, tap a side to turn, or use the D-pad. Take on one, two or three DS riders; first to three rounds is champion.

games.title: Tree Chop
games.tagline: Chop fast, dodge the branches
games.details: A giant tree towers over both screens. Tap left or right to step around the trunk and chop the bottom log - the whole tree drops down. Keep your head clear of the branches, and keep chopping, because the timer drains faster the higher your score climbs.

games.title: Turn Twin
games.tagline: Turned round - or flipped over too?
games.details: A quick test of your mind's eye. Two block shapes sit side by side: the right one is always the left one turned round, and sometimes flipped over as well. Tap SAME if turning alone would match it, MIRROR if it has been flipped. Shapes grow bigger and the clock gets shorter; a run of right answers multiplies the score, and three wrong calls end the game.

games.title: Twin Lanes
games.tagline: Two cars, one driver
games.details: Drive two cars at once down a road that runs the length of both screens. Tap the left half of the touch screen to switch the red car's lane and the right half for the blue car. Catch every circle, dodge every square - and keep your head as the road speeds up.

games.title: Two Bins
games.tagline: Sort fast - the rule keeps changing
games.details: A quick-reaction sorting game. Shapes drop in one at a time; tap the left or right side to send each to its bin. The rule at the top says what goes where - warm colours or cool, round or pointed, big or small - and every few items it changes, later even swapping sides. The clock gets shorter and a run of right answers multiplies your score. Three wrong bins and the game is over.

games.title: Two Tone
games.tagline: Light and dark, perfectly balanced
games.details: A clean logic puzzle in two tones. Fill every square light or dark: never three alike side by side, every row and column half and half, and no two rows or columns the same. Mistakes glow red as you go. 90 puzzles on 6x6, 8x8 and 10x10 grids, each with exactly one answer.

games.title: Beach Volley
games.tagline: Bump it over - first to seven
games.details: One-on-one volleyball on a sunny beach that fills both screens. Run, jump and bump the ball over the net, and angle your hits so it lands on the far side. Play the DS at three levels or share the DS with a friend, with D-pad or stylus controls. First to seven points wins.

games.title: Wall Race
games.tagline: Race to the far side - and wall in your rival
games.details: A tense race-and-block strategy game on a nine-by-nine board. Each turn, step your pawn one square or put down a two-square wall in the grooves to lengthen your rival's route. Walls can never cross and must always leave a way through, and you only have ten. Hop the other pawn when you meet. Take on the DS at three levels - it weighs every possible wall against both shortest paths - or play a friend on one console.

games.title: Word Hunt
games.tagline: Find every hidden word
games.details: A relaxing word search with fourteen themes - animals, fruit, space, the ocean, castles and more. Drag across the letter grid to circle each hidden word; harder puzzles hide them diagonally and backwards too. Words are ticked off on the top screen, and quick finds earn bonus points.

games.title: Word Shuffle
games.tagline: Unscramble the word before time runs out
games.details: A quick-fire word game. Each word from the shown theme has had its letters jumbled - tap the tiles in order to spell it, and take letters back with a tap if you change your mind. Faster answers score more. Shuffle the tray for a fresh look, use a hint when stuck, and skip if you must - but only three skips per game.
